values.note: Full-hookup camper sites from $46 a night on the campground's own booking page (C21 from $48); riverfront tent sites from $37.20, cabin from $139.60. Paid in full at booking.

fees.source: https://www.riverbankcampground.net/book-a-site ('C1 Camper Up To 33 Feet W/S/E ... From $46', 'C21 Camper Up To 33 Feet W/S/E ... From $48'), rendered in a browser 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.riverbankcampground.net/ ('All camper sites are full hook-up, W/S/E with 30/50 Amp service') + https://www.riverbankcampground.net/book-a-site ('has 50/30 amp service with water and sewer hook-ups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Camper sites are back-in only and listed for campers up to 33-34 ft (one titled 36 ft); 'We cannot accommodate any Class A RVs over 32'.' Bridge clearance on the way in is 13 ft 6 in. Also riverfront tent sites (about 20 x 40 ft) and a cabin.

sites.source: https://www.riverbankcampground.net/book-a-site ('Site is back in only ... will accommodate a camper up to 33 feet long', 'C2 Camper Up To 36 Feet ... up to 34 feet long', 'Bridge clearance is 13' 6"') + https://www.riverbankcampground.net/ ('We cannot accommodate any Class A RVs over 32''), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Book online on the campground's own site; reservations are paid in full when made. Camper check-in 5-9 pm, check-out by 2 pm. Full refund less a 3% card fee 30+ days out, 50% at 15-29 days, none inside 15 days. Seasonal sites, worker stays and dump-station use by inquiry.

booking.source: https://www.riverbankcampground.net/terms-and-conditions ('Reservations must be paid for at time of booking', 'Check in for campground (not Cabin) is after 5pm with no exception, check out is by 2pm', cancellation terms) + https://www.riverbankcampground.net/book-a-site ('Check in between 5pm and 9pm no exceptions') + https://www.riverbankcampground.net/ (seasonal sites and dump station by message), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed full hookups (30/50A, water, sewer) on every camper site and the $46 base on the campground's own booking widget. Added back-in sites for campers to about 33-34 ft (Class A over 32 ft refused), 13'6" bridge, operator booking URL, check-in/cancellation terms. Dump station left as recorded (offered to non-guests by message). Not stated: site count, season, showers.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says the campground is 'on the banks of the Raystown branch of the Juniata River' and sells 'T3/T4 Tent Site Riverfront' ('located near the water') and a riverbank cabin; the camper sites are not described as riverfront. Stored value is 'not waterfront'.
